verdict.rationale: GitBook documents GitHub & GitLab Sync as part of a dedicated docs-as-code section, and states you can 'sync from Git' with 'Git workflows built in'. It also lists preview deployments, which fits a branch/PR review flow. The evidence is mostly feature titles, though, without detail on how branches, pull requests, and merges map to published content. missing for 10: explicit documentation of branch-to-site mapping and merge-triggered publishing, PR preview details, independent hands-on corroboration of the Git-driven workflow.
